content.title: Fix BUG-2: sync push/pull returns 500 (passes worktree dir instead of project root)
content.description:
Phase 4 validation found that POST /api/sync/push and POST /api/sync/pull return 500 (NOT_INITIALIZED), so the 'Push button syncs changes' and 'Pull button fetches changes' acceptance criteria are only partially met (frontend triggers the calls correctly, backend fails).

ROOT CAUSE (in webapp server, packages/webapp/server/routes/sync.ts:4,11,21):
const cwd = process.env.AGENTRACK_CWD || process.cwd();
pushWorktree(cwd) / pullWorktree(cwd) are called with cwd directly. But pushWorktree/pullWorktree expect the PROJECT ROOT (where .agentrack.json lives), not the tracker/worktree directory. In the e2e environment AGENTRACK_CWD points to validation/.e2edata/ (the worktree), so the functions cannot find .agentrack.json and return NOT_INITIALIZED -> 500.

The fix should resolve the project root (e.g. via resolveTrackerDir or walking up to find .agentrack.json) instead of passing cwd verbatim.

NOTE: In normal production usage (AGENTRACK_CWD unset, cwd = process.cwd() = project root) sync likely works; the bug manifests whenever AGENTRACK_CWD points at the worktree/tracker dir rather than the project root. The e2e tests cannot validate push/pull end-to-end until this is fixed.

Currently 'documented' only as a code comment in e2e/phase4-validation.spec.ts (BUG-2) and the tests assert the 500 — so the bug is locked in as passing. When fixed, those tests must be updated to assert success.

Awaiting decision — on accept I'll plan implementation children; on discard I'll close with idea,discarded.

Implementation planned (idea ACCEPTED as library bug).

DECISION: Library-level fix (reviewer's preferred approach — robust, benefits CLI too). The root cause is in the library (pushWorktree/pullWorktree don't resolve the project root), so the fix belongs there.

PHASES (reproduction skipped — the review mqe1imzt2i already contains a code-verified reproduction confirmed by the existing phase4 e2e tests asserting the 500):
1. Dev (mqe2xmq47c, library-developer): Fix pushWorktree/pullWorktree to resolve project root + read branch pointer for {branch, dir} opts. Also flip phase4 test assertions from 500 to success.
2. Validate (mqe2xmdugp, library-validator): Run phase4 e2e suite + library unit tests, verify end-to-end.
3. Release (mqe2xmprgj, library-releaser): Version bump + publish.
4. Sync (mqe2xmxeiv, project-manager): Verify + close.

The dev task description includes the reviewer's CRITICAL refinement: resolveTrackerDir returns the data dir, not the project root, and the worktree uses a custom branch/dir (_e2edata/.e2edata) — so the fix must resolve the project root AND read the branch pointer, not just call resolveTrackerDir.
